needs_sign_in.list_payment_methods: reads a signed-in SkyMiles member's wallet

actions.select_fare: picks a fare on the results page; adds nothing to pay
actions.select_fare_experience: picks a fare experience and creates the cart

checkout_actions.open_seat_map: opens the seat map; chooses no seat
checkout_actions.select_seat: holds a seat, refusing any with a fee unless the task allows one
checkout_actions.skip_seat_selection: leaves the seat map without saving
checkout_actions.continue_to_review_and_pay: moves from Trip Summary to Review and Pay; enters no data
checkout_actions.continue_checkout: saves one checkout step; never presses Complete Purchase
